items.title: President Trump’s Immigration Policies Are Saving American Lives
items.summary:
Traffic fatalities have fallen to the second-lowest level in American history following President Donald J. Trump’s crackdown on illegal alien truck drivers. That good news joins sharp drops in traffic deaths, overdoses, violent crime, and border fatalities after the largest immigration enforcement surge in modern history — while Democrats’ open-border policies left chaos, missing kids, […]
